paragraphs.text: RikkaHub fork，Android AI 客户端。支持 IM（类 Grok-Bot）模式，ChatGPT 订阅登录使用、跨应用划词悬浮翻译、高性能低延迟远程云电脑控制。

Miffan
An Android AI app you talk to like a friend, with partners that team up and can work on your
Android AI app you talk to like a friend, with partners that team up and can work on your computer.
English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文
Bring the AI service you already use, whether that's an API key for an OpenAI-compatible, Gemini or
Claude service, a ChatGPT subscription through Codex sign-in, an OpenRouter account, or a Magpie gat
eway on your own computer. Miffan doesn't bundle a model. Your chats and settings stay on your phone
way on your own computer. Miffan doesn't bundle a model. Your chats and settings stay on your phone.
## Chat like a messenger
Each AI partner is one ongoing chat. There's nothing to start and nothing you have to tune.
- **One partner, one conversation.** Your history with a partner reads as one timeline across days.
Behind the scenes Miffan keeps topics apart, so long chats stay quick and on point. A divider shows

where a new topic began, and one tap continues the last topic instead.
- **Ask several things at onc

e.** Unrelated questions run in parallel, and each reply quotes the message it answers.
- **Quick an
swers or careful ones.** On a partner's page, choose how long it thinks before replying, from instan

t to thinking deeply. For one hard question, pick "Think hard this time" in the + menu.
- **Abilitie
s when they're needed.** When a partner needs your calendar, clipboard or screen time, it asks in th

e chat and carries on once you allow it.
- **Change a partner by telling it.** "Keep your answers sh
orter" adjusts its preferences. With your approval a partner can also change its own name, avatar an
d instructions. Every change is linked to the message behind it, kept in a history and can be undone

.
- **See what AI knows about you.** Each memory shows where it came from, and you can delete it at

any time.
- **Ask for a picture.** Pick a drawing model once and any partner can draw, or edit its l

ast picture when you say "change it to…".
- **Keep what matters.** Long-press a message to save it.
The Discover tab gathers your saved messages and recent drawings, and lets you draw or translate wit
hout picking a partner.

Long chats stay one timeline
See what it remembers
The Discover tab
## Partners that work together
Partners can message each other, and you can bring several into one chat.
- **Group chats.** A host partner splits the work, mentioned partners reply at the same time, and yo

u're notified only when someone mentions you.
- **Mention anyone.** Type @ in a chat to bring in ano

ther partner.
- **Your chat list, your way.** Pin partners, sort them into groups, and see at a glan

ce who's working (green) or waiting for your approval (blinking amber).
- **Kept apart.** A partner
only recalls chats it took part in, and first contact between two partners needs your OK.
## Let your partner use your computer
Connect a Mac, Windows or Linux computer over SSH, including over Tailscale or, when you're out, thr
ough Miffan's free relay, and your partner can open apps, type and click on it while you watch from
your phone. A server or NAS without a screen works too: the partner uses it through commands.
- **One shared screen.** View and control the desktop from your phone, in portrait or full-screen la
ndscape. While the partner works, the first touch only asks; a second touch takes over. On a Mac or

Linux computer you can also show just one window, sized to fit your phone.
- **High-performance mode
.** With Sunshine on the computer, the graphics card encodes the picture for lower latency, smoother

motion and sound. Miffan sets it up and pairs for you.
- **You stay in charge.** Choose per compute
r whether the partner asks first, works on its own or leaves it alone. Each approval is recorded in

a permission history that stays even if you delete the chat.
- **Tasks that run on schedule.** Ask a
partner to do something every morning and the computer's own scheduler runs it on time, even while
your phone is off (Mac and Linux). A task can be a command or a call to an AI tool already installed
there, such as Claude Code, Codex CLI or Gemini CLI. Results come back to the chat when you open Mi

ffan, and "My computers" keeps the output of every run.
- **See how a computer is doing.** A status
page says in one line whether the computer is ready, fixes problems in place and offers updates for

the control helper.
- **A mini box of its own.** Rather keep a partner off your desktop? Give it its
own separate mini box on your Mac, Windows or Linux computer. It works freely there and hands finis

hed files to a folder on your computer.
- **Easy to connect.** Easy chat finds computers on your Wi-
Fi and on Tailscale. Sign in once with the account password and Miffan switches to its own key; Wind

ows gets a one-step setup script.
- **Away from home too.** When you're not on the computer's networ
k, partners reach it through Miffan's free relay, with no Tailscale needed. You can also use a relay
t through Miffan's free relay, with no Tailscale needed. You can also use a relay you host yourself.

Watch it work
[该节后续省略]
## Approve with a tap
When a partner wants to do something that matters, such as running a command, scheduling a task, add
ing a calendar event or calling an MCP tool, it asks with a card you can read: one sentence on what
it wants to do and the key details, with the raw call one tap away.
- Allow several ordinary requests at once, or always allow a kind of action and take that back later

in the permission history.
- Adjust a calendar event's time before it's added.
- When a partner has

a question, tap an option or write your own answer.
- Open any finished change to see exactly what
it did, then undo or redo just that change.
## Professional mode when you want every option
Switch to the professional interface at any time. It uses the same data as easy chat.

- Combine official APIs, compatible gateways, self-hosted endpoints and a Codex subscription.
- Give

each assistant its own prompts, model parameters, memory, MCP servers, Skills and web search.
- Run
a local Linux workspace on the phone, or let assistants work on remote servers over SSH with files

and a terminal.
- Use voice input and output, translate selected text in any app, and chat from a br
owser on your network.
The feature matrix lists every supported provider, search service, speech engine and tool.
